_about: AI-written visual descriptions ("Scene" sections) removed from this deck on 2026-10-04 at PlayfulProcess's word. See README.md in this folder.
deck_name: Oswald Wirth Tarot — The 22 Esoteric Arcana (1889 / 1926)

arcanum-00-le-fou.name: 0 — The Fool
arcanum-00-le-fou.Scene: A young man in parti-coloured costume and cap with bells walks forward, carrying a bag on a stick over his shoulder. A small dog or wolf nips at his heels and tears his coat. He gazes upward, apparently unaware of the precipice ahead. Hebrew letter Shin (ש) appears on the card.

arcanum-01-le-bateleur.name: 1 — The Magician
arcanum-01-le-bateleur.Scene: A conjurer stands at a table covered with small objects — cups, coins, a knife, and a wand. He wears a wide-brimmed figure-eight hat (the hat encodes the lemniscate or infinity symbol) and holds a wand upright. A pentagram is shown on his belt. Hebrew letter Aleph (א).

arcanum-02-la-papesse.name: 2 — The High Priestess
arcanum-02-la-papesse.Scene: A woman in papal tiara and blue and white robes sits enthroned between two pillars. She holds a book on her lap — the Torah or book of secret law — partially covered by her robe. Hebrew letter Beth (ב).

arcanum-03-limperatrice.name: 3 — The Empress
arcanum-03-limperatrice.Scene: A winged empress is enthroned in a garden, crowned with stars. She holds a sceptre topped with an orb or cross and a heart-shaped shield with an eagle. A wheat field may appear at her feet. Hebrew letter Gimel (ג).

arcanum-04-lempereur.name: 4 — The Emperor
arcanum-04-lempereur.Scene: A bearded emperor in armour sits on a cubic stone throne, holding a sceptre. His posture is formal and frontal. A ram's head may appear on the throne. Hebrew letter Daleth (ד).

arcanum-05-le-pape.name: 5 — The Hierophant
arcanum-05-le-pape.Scene: A pope in triple tiara sits between two pillars or obelisks and raises his right hand in a two-fingered benediction. Two kneeling acolytes face him. A triple cross or key is visible. Hebrew letter Heh (ה).

arcanum-06-lamoureux.name: 6 — The Lovers
arcanum-06-lamoureux.Scene: A young man stands at a crossroads between two women — a crowned virtuous woman on his right and a sensual woman on his left — while a winged Cupid above aims an arrow at him. Hebrew letter Vav (ו).

arcanum-07-le-chariot.name: 7 — The Chariot
arcanum-07-le-chariot.Scene: A crowned warrior in armour stands erect in a four-pillared canopy chariot. Two sphinxes (one black, one white) sit before the chariot in place of horses; he does not hold reins but commands by will alone. Hebrew letter Zain (ז).

arcanum-08-la-justice.name: 8 — Justice
arcanum-08-la-justice.Scene: A crowned woman in red and blue sits on a throne, holding an upright sword in her right hand and a balanced scale in her left. Hebrew letter Cheth (ח).

arcanum-09-lermite.name: 9 — The Hermit
arcanum-09-lermite.Scene: An aged hermit in a grey robe walks bent over his staff, holding a hexagonal lantern in his raised left hand. Snow or a desolate mountain landscape surrounds him. Hebrew letter Teth (ט) or Yod (י).

arcanum-10-la-roue.name: 10 — Wheel of Fortune
arcanum-10-la-roue.Scene: A large wheel inscribed with the letters T-A-R-O or T-O-R-A (an anagram) turns at the centre. On the wheel's rim: a golden sphinx at top holds a sword; a human figure or Hermanubis rises on the right; a red Set or Typhon falls on the left. Hebrew letter Kaph (כ).

arcanum-11-la-force.name: 11 — Strength
arcanum-11-la-force.Scene: A woman in white robes and a floral crown or lemniscate hat gently holds open the jaws of a lion. Her expression and posture are entirely calm. Hebrew letter Lamed (ל).

arcanum-12-le-pendu.name: 12 — The Hanged Man
arcanum-12-le-pendu.Scene: A young man hangs by his right ankle from a living tree or wooden cross-bar set between two trees. His free leg is crossed behind the suspended one, forming an inverted tau cross. His face is serene or illuminated. Hebrew letter Mem (מ).

arcanum-13-la-mort.name: 13 — Death
arcanum-13-la-mort.Scene: A skeleton in black armour mows a field with a great scythe, harvesting a crop of heads, hands, and crowns. A bishop's mitre appears among the fallen. The skeleton looks directly forward. Hebrew letter Nun (נ).

arcanum-14-la-temperance.name: 14 — Temperance
arcanum-14-la-temperance.Scene: A winged angel in robes pours liquid between two pitchers — one of gold, one of silver — in a continuous stream. Solar and lunar discs or symbols may appear on the angel's robe. Hebrew letter Samech (ס).

arcanum-15-le-diable.name: 15 — The Devil
arcanum-15-le-diable.Scene: A bat-winged horned devil crouches on a pedestal. Between its legs a fire burns. Below, a man and a woman — each with a tail — are chained to the pedestal by the neck. An inverted pentagram appears on the devil's forehead. Hebrew letter Ayin (ע).

arcanum-16-la-maison-dieu.name: 16 — The Tower
arcanum-16-la-maison-dieu.Scene: A stone tower on a rocky promontory is struck by lightning from a stormy sky; the crown or battlement is blasted off in a shower of flames. Two figures fall headlong from the tower. The card is titled 'Le Feu du Ciel' (Heavenly Fire) in the Wirth edition. Hebrew letter Peh (פ).

arcanum-17-les-etoiles.name: 17 — The Star
arcanum-17-les-etoiles.Scene: A nude woman kneels at the edge of a pool, pouring water from two pitchers — one onto the earth, one into the water. Above, a large eight-pointed star is surrounded by seven smaller stars. A bird (ibis) sits in a tree behind her. Hebrew letter Tzaddi (צ).

arcanum-18-la-lune.name: 18 — The Moon
arcanum-18-la-lune.Scene: A crescent moon — showing a full face in profile — shines down over a path winding between two crenellated towers toward distant mountains. A crayfish emerges from a pool at the bottom. Two dogs (one domestic, one wolf) stand on either side howling at the moon. Hebrew letter Qoph (ק).

arcanum-19-le-soleil.name: 19 — The Sun
arcanum-19-le-soleil.Scene: A radiant sun with a human face, ringed by alternating straight and wavy rays, shines overhead. Below, two young children hold hands in a garden enclosed by a low stone wall. Sunflowers may grow at the wall. Hebrew letter Resh (ר).

arcanum-20-le-jugement.name: 20 — Judgement
arcanum-20-le-jugement.Scene: An angel or archangel blows a trumpet from within clouds above; from open coffins below, three figures — a man, a woman, and a child — rise with arms stretched upward toward the angel. The coffins float on water. Hebrew letter Shin (ש).

arcanum-21-le-monde.name: 21 — The World
arcanum-21-le-monde.Scene: A nude or lightly draped androgynous figure dances within an oval wreath of laurel. The dancer holds two wands. At the four corners appear the four fixed-sign creatures of Ezekiel's chariot: the angel of Aquarius, the eagle of Scorpio, the lion of Leo, and the bull of Taurus. Hebrew letter Tau (ת).

emg-the-great-work.name: The Major Arcana as the Great Work
emg-the-great-work.Scene: An 1889 coloured engraving showing all 22 Major Arcana of the Wirth deck arranged in three rows. The image is titled 'Les 22 Arcanes du Tarot Kabbalistique' and presents the full Wirth sequence as a unified system of initiatic teaching.
